content: Olo Xahohisakoatyaka Judéia Koa Yerenai Tyakekohatiyenai Ana
Etake olo xaxikahenere Judéia koa yerenai ana tahiya atyo maisa xoare naxairahitita xomana.

Waiyekehalakita atyo nomani xakahinaetyahene xaokowitere tahi akiti, hoka hatyo hiyeta naexakeretya xiso wihinaehare Macedônia yerenai hiye. Noxakai xiso wihinaeharenai Grécia nali tyaoniterenai memere xisaonitere xikahinaerahene kakoa hetatiye jiyehenere terehokoane tahi. Hoka tyotyaha ihalahareha xiyaokalita xakahinaetya maoloxaharenai xaokowitere tahi kakoa.
Hoka kalikini naxikahena exe wihinaeharenai hoka naexakerehenere xiso hatyo tahi akiti kakoa maisa xoare makaotyakeneta maheta. Hoka maika niraetere akereta ximemere xisaona xikahinaerahene kakoa.

Hiyaiya, Macedônia yerenaiya tyoaha noximi hoka maisa ximemere xisaonare hoka wihaihareya, exahe tehitiyaiya hoka xihaihare. Maisa xihaiharene tahi wiraeta maheta, wityakekotere xiso hiyeta nahekotya.

Hatyo hiyeta waiye xaxikatyakala wihinaeharenai nahiti maniya hoka memere mokaha maheta olo xisa xaokowiterehare. Hoka nali nokaokihena hoka koxaka memere tyaonita maheta, hoka tyotyaha semaha maheta xiyaokalita xisa xaokowihenere xiyekane, hoka maisa xiwakatyaka xema xini xisehenerehare tahi.
Xotyaxematyaira exeharenai: Xala xamaniya atyo inira fitya hoka iniraiya atyo imexaheta. Hoka xala xamaniya atyo kalore fitya hoka kaloreya atyo imexaheta.

Hoka maika hatya xakini, aliyakere xamani ahekotya hoka nikarexe isa. Maisa haxamaikoharene, hawakatyaka xema hekoti xini. Hiyaiya, xala xamani atyo haihalaharene kakoa ijita hoka Enore atyo awaiyetitene.
Hoka Enoreya atyo isa xomana xaokitereharenai xahexe hoka xaokitereharenai kakoare xisaota mene maheta, exahe xaokiterehare xahexe isa xomana hoka waiyexe xisomehitiya maheta.
Hiyaiya, exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: “Kahare atyo xoalinihare ijita maoloxaharenai ana. Enawaiyexehare atyo maisa tyotere xini”, nexa.

content: Enore atyo hanakatise ijita kaxafityaka maheta, exahe nakairati hoka ijita kakanakairatyaka maheta. Hoka isa tehitiyaite xomana tyotya hanakatise xaokitereharenai. Hoka akekoaretya ite hatyo hanakatise hoka kalore ite ximexehetene maoloxaharenai xikahinaera hiyeta.
Xikaoloxahare ite moka mene xakahinaetya maheta halitinae. Nikare ite hoka kahareha ite ihalahareha Enore kakoa olo xaxikaitere wiyema hiyeta.
Hiyaiya, exakere atyo xisomita hoka maisa atyo xakahinaetita taita xini Enore koamaniya tyaoniterenae maxiyehareharenai, xakore hoka xisomitereharenai hiyeta atyo kalore ihalaharahitaha Enore kakoa.

Ihalaharehenahaite Enore kakoa. Hiyaiya, exe xikahinaera atyo hotikijita xityakekone, exahe xawenane Cristo nalitare Iraiti Waiyexe xema. Hoka olo xaxikaitere enomanaha, exahe haiyaharenae ana xoaha hiyeta ite ihalahareha tehitiya Enore kakoa.
Iraexatyaha ite xomana haxawaiyeraha xiso hiyeta, exahe Enore kalore awaiyetitere xiso xoaha hiyeta.
Nikahena hoka wihalahare Enore kakoa, hatyo kalore awaiyetitere wiso maxaimenekotyakahare kakoa hiyeta.
